text: August 2026: we cleaned the concrete paths, portico and patio at a Bilinga home, washed the front balcony and cleaned the external windows. The side path started out dull, dusty and stained red, and finished a clean, deep red beside the brick planter.
alt: Before and after of the side patio beside white wall. Before: Dull, dusty red concrete path with puddle, chairs and a timber sleeper. After: in Bilinga
